observations.behavior: Documentation update: badge status changed from optional to recommended, and several Markdown and code examples were replaced.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that Python exception autocapture is recommended rather than optional, and provides updated setup instructions for Django, Flask, and ASGI frameworks.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: Django middleware setup instructions and configuration example were replaced.
observations.code_quote: Add the Django middleware to your settings. It wraps each request in a [context](https://posthog.com/docs/libraries/python#contexts) and captures exceptions raised by your views.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the middleware's behavior and configuration, including the POSTHOG_MW_CLIENT setting and its relationship to the global client.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: Django REST Framework exception handler setup and configuration instructions were added.
observations.code_quote: If you configure the global client instead, with \`posthog.api_key\` and \`posthog.host\`, leave \`POSTHOG_MW_CLIENT\` unset.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies configuration compatibility between global client and middleware, and adds DRF exception handler setup.
